cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: More Power, More Problems
cards.instruction: Celebrate every burden, restriction, or crisis as evidence that your influence is expanding.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Another complaint about me! This hotel's attention is finally concentrating where it belongs.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm taking you off reception while I investigate.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I authorize you to give the investigation your full attention. Wonderful to have management working on my affairs.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm not working for you. You'll write the complaint replies from the laundry office.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I approve the new correspondence office. Send paper there; if reception and management weren't enough, now my affairs are reaching into laundry.

reason: Rereading found permission words too easily removable from the existing Drive conversation. Make B explicitly respond to A attempted assignment of the investigation, then let A approve the imposed office as further influence.
